children: America's Car-Mart obtained a series of waiver arrangements under its Credit and Guaranty Agreement as it navigates near-term covenant challenges and evaluates strategic alternatives. The company first secured a limited waiver through September 7, 2026, then received an initial extension to September 11, 2026, and a second extension to September 18, 2026, from Silver Point Finance, as Administrative Agent, and participating lenders. Management said discussions with third parties and lenders remain active as it works toward a longer-term transaction and sustainable capital structure.

: Provide covenant relief during strategic alternatives review
Agreement 2: America's Car-Mart Extends Credit Waiver to Sep 11 With Silver Point
: Extension of waiver under Credit and Guaranty Agreement

: Allow more time to negotiate financing and strategic options

: Preserve liquidity while advancing a potential transaction
